item.title: Yandere
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nekomarudou
  • 発売日: 2007-08-17
  • スコア: 5.14/10 (1204 人評価)
  • 日本語名: やんデレ
  • 英語名: Yandere

别名

  • やんデレ 〜ダイスキ ダカラ ■シタイ〜

あらすじ

This is a kill or be killed brutal and deadly love story. Can you stay alive all the way to the ending?

The girls are all violently possessive and go head over heels after sex. Every single one of them is sick!!

Please be aware that there are elements in the story that the faint of heart may find too grotesque.

item.title: Tori no Naku Koro
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nekomarudou
  • 発売日: 2006-12-31
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 禽ノ哭ク刻 -トリノナクコロ-
  • 英語名: Tori no Naku Koro

あらすじ

Four years have passed since the incident. Main character continues to attend the school, play with friends and laugh. One night he meets a girl with black wings on her back - Jabberwock.

“You look so delicious”

Everyday life breaks down in an instant. With the help of prestigious evil hunter and holy warrior from Vatican protagonist opposes the new threat.

item.title: Oni no Warau Koro
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nekomarudou
  • 発売日: 2005-12-30
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 邪ノ嗤フ刻
  • 英語名: Oni no Warau Koro

あらすじ

Main character fights evil every day and searches for his relative. One day he helps to an attacked girl, and shortly after the whole city starts to overflow with evil and people moving upon commands. The key to the tragedy seems to be hidden in the mysterious girl. A red flashback pierces protagonist’s mind. The tragedy repeats itself. This time he won’t allow to lose everything again.
